WITH aci_list AS (SELECT x AS aci_val FROM UNNEST(['A','B','C','D','E','F','G']) AS x),
rules AS (
  SELECT ID, fixed_amount, rate, aci FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees`
  WHERE card_scheme = 'GlobalCard' AND (is_credit = TRUE OR is_credit IS NULL)
),
matched AS (
  SELECT r.ID, a.aci_val, r.fixed_amount + r.rate * 100 / 10000 AS fee_100
  FROM rules r CROSS JOIN aci_list a
  WHERE ARRAY_LENGTH(r.aci) = 0 OR a.aci_val IN UNNEST(r.aci)
)
SELECT aci_val, COUNT(*) AS n_rules, ROUND(MIN(fee_100),4) AS min_fee, ROUND(AVG(fee_100),4) AS avg_fee, ROUND(MAX(fee_100),4) AS max_fee
FROM matched GROUP BY aci_val ORDER BY avg_fee DESC, aci_val ASC
